rationale: The plan correctly frames the question as a 2x2 factorial interaction, fits ~ condition + time + condition:time with explicit reference levels (control, t0), tests the interaction coefficient by Wald test with an edgeR QL F-test as a robustness check, and extracts both simple effects with ashr shrinkage while keeping p-values from the unshrunken fit. QC (blind VST, PCA, distance heatmap, library sizes, coloured by condition and time) precedes modelling with a stated outlier policy, the pre-filter is minimal and justified by the smallest cell size, and normalization stays inside the models. The unrequested enrichment is technically well specified (full ranked list, Wald statistic, tested-gene universe, named human collections, 15-500 window, seed) and appropriately caveated as exploratory, though it adds length without being warranted by the question. The report section covers method, versions, design, thresholds, tested/significant counts, and an explicit low-power caveat for the interaction at n=3 per cell.
